title: The Room Where Finished Things Learn to Leave

features.name: open-shed-releasing
features.desc-on-touch: A small weatherboard shed with its door swung wide. Everything inside it is carefully packed and ready to depart. The shed itself seems relieved.

features.name: path-of-dispersal
features.desc-on-touch: A path that branches infinitely, each branch carrying something finished toward its own horizon. No path is more true than another.

features.name: shopfront-of-goodbyes
features.desc-on-touch: A vacant storefront with its shelves empty, its window dark. Everything it held is now somewhere else, saying what it needs to say.

features.name: knowledge-in-flight
features.desc-on-touch: Scattered pages rising, each one carrying completed understanding toward its own reader. The archive exhales; the words learn where they belong.

features.name: threshold-where-completion-ends
features.desc-on-touch: A doorway you have already passed through. On both sides of it, things are still learning that they were finished all along.

inscription: here all finished things learn they have been breathing the whole time; departure is not an ending but the first true motion of what was complete

file.name: Finished_Projects_Distribution_Archive.txt
